title: Use the Map View
description: Visualize your notes on a map with location-based organization

steps.title: Open Map View
steps.description: Click the map icon in the sidebar or press Ctrl+M

steps.title: Map Interface
steps.description: The map shows notes with location properties as markers. Clustered markers indicate multiple notes in one area.

steps.title: Add Location to Note
steps.description: Open a note, add a 'location' property with coordinates or place name

steps.title: Set Location
steps.description: Enter 'location' as key, '=' as operator, and 'San Francisco, CA' as value

steps.title: Confirm Location
steps.description: Click Add detail to save the location

steps.title: Marker Appears
steps.description: Return to map view and verify a marker appears for your note
